last_message:
I haven't made the change. The repository records that this exact switch was already tried and undone, and the reason it was undone is worth more than 40 euros a month.

`docs/features/pickup-reminders.md` explains why reminders go by SMS:

- **Reminders went by email from April to June 2025.** The email provider reported that 34% of reminder emails were never opened.
- **Missed pickups more than doubled,** from 6% of pantry orders to 13%. Each missed pickup is a packed bag of fresh food that gets thrown away at closing time.
- **The cause:** many members share one family phone and never check email, but they do see a text.
- **SMS came back on July 1, 2025,** and missed pickups were down to 6% again by August.
- **This keeps coming up.** Issue 52 was the third request to switch to email in one year.

The code change itself is one line, and the email branch is still there from the trial. In `larder/reminders.py:1`:

```python
CHANNEL = "email"
```

If you still want to switch after reading this, say so and I'll make that edit. I'll also update `docs/features/pickup-reminders.md`, which describes SMS as the current channel. If the main concern is the 40 euros, other options may work better: a cheaper SMS provider, email for members who confirm they read it, or email plus an SMS only when the email goes unopened.
